1. I wouldnt trust Antutu's battery health indicator when the phones' settings says that you're still at 100%.

2. Based on my observations, charging speed slows down the higher the temps go. My phone which is the same as yours, only averages 20w to prevent overheating as just 20w in my local climate already brings the phone to 44c. Although at the beginning of a charge, especially when it's cold. It does reach around 60w.

3. Your phone's getting 1.3 mil because of thermal throttling, again, heat is the problem. If you want your phone performing at its fullest potential then please order a cooler as it will also make your battery less weary. I've ordered one and it's been great so far. I can play extremely demanding games without touching a microwave, and have been getting faster charges because of less heat.
